ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A barcode of the type shown in the two examples is composed of alternate strips of black and white, where the leftmost and rightmost strips are always black. Each strip (of either colour) has a width of 1 or 2 . The total width of the barcode is 12 . The barcodes are always read from left to right. How many distinct barcodes are possible?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached image there are two example barcodes, both vertical black bars arranged from left to right on a white background, and the white gaps between the black bars are also regarded as white bars. The examples show that the barcodes are composed of alternating black and white bars, and both the leftmost end and the rightmost end are black bars; the barcodes are read from left to right. Reasoning: Treat a barcode as a sequence of bar widths from left to right. Each bar width can only be 1 or 2, and the total width is 12. Because the first bar is black and the colors alternate, the last bar is black if and only if the total number of bars k is odd. If there are k bars in total, among which t bars have width 2 and the remaining bars have width 1, then the total width is k+t=12, so t=12-k. It is also necessary that 0≤t≤k, so the valid odd k are 7, 9, and 11. The count is: when k=7, t=5, there are C(7,5)=21 kinds; when k=9, t=3, there are C(9,3)=84 kinds; when k=11, t=1, there are C(11,1)=11 kinds. The total number is 21+84+11=116.

method.method_draft: First inspect the image: the examples make clear that the barcode is a sequence of alternating colored vertical strips, not a set of independent bars, and the black-white pattern is forced once the first strip is black. From the text, each strip contributes width 1 or 2 and the total width must be 12. Use a generating-function or recurrence model. Let A(x) = x + x^2 represent the possible width of one strip. Because the barcode must start and end black, the number of strips must be odd, so the generating function for all valid barcodes is A(x) + A(x)^3 + A(x)^5 + ... = A(x)/(1 - A(x)^2). The desired count is the coefficient of x^12 in this expression. Equivalently compute coefficients of odd powers: [x^12](x+x^2)^7 + [x^12](x+x^2)^9 + [x^12](x+x^2)^11, giving 21 + 84 + 11 = 116.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中的两个示例都由竖直黑色条和白色间隔交替组成；最左边和最右边看到的条都是黑色。白色间隔不是无关背景，而是与黑色条交替出现的白色条，因此整个条码可看作从左到右的一串交替颜色条。推理：因为最左条为黑色，颜色交替后，若最右条也为黑色，则条的总数必须是奇数。每一条的宽度可以是 1 或 2，所以单条宽度的生成函数为 A(x)=x+x^2。所有合法条码的生成函数为 A(x)+A(x)^3+A(x)^5+...=A(x)/(1-A(x)^2)。要求总宽度为 12，即求 x^12 的系数。奇数条数 n 必须满足 n≤12≤2n，所以可能的奇数 n 为 7, 9, 11。对 n 条而言，(x+x^2)^n=x^n(1+x)^n，x^12 的系数是 C(n,12-n)。因此总数为 C(7,5)+C(9,3)+C(11,1)=21+84+11=116。条码从左到右读取，所以不同宽度序列算作不同条码。
